result:
Phase 4 complete. All lanes wired, all gates green.

## What landed

**`next.config.ts`** — the `/nocturne/:path*` frame-hardening block (CSP `frame-ancestors 'self'` + `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`), identical to the sibling six.

**`public/nocturne/favicon.svg`** — night-watch mark: crescent moon over a watchtower with a lit window, one gold accent dot; mirrors the parley/aria sibling style (32×32, `#0d0b14` token bg, two-tone strokes). Rendered + verified at 4×.

**`src/components/landing/live-demo-data.ts`** — gallery entry #7 `nocturne`: route `/nocturne`, `unown-nine.vercel.app/nocturne?embed=1`, poster `/landing/nocturne/poster.png` with a dashboard-describing alt, `resetType "nocturne-reset"` (the operator's fixed value, untouched), and the receipt block counted from the round's real telemetry: **19 sessions** (N1–N19 in `benchmarks/nocturne-round/ux-ledger.md`), **103 files** (`find src/lib/nocturne src/app/nocturne src/components/nocturne -type f`), **466 tests** (360 + 78 + 28), **4 commits** (`c61c64c` plan → `ae8defe` domain → `a769ada` api → `d697079` ui; the operator's snapshot/housekeeping commits excluded), toolCalls `0` with an inline note that the count lands at round close per the aria convention, `receiptDoc` → `docs/nocturne-demo-session.md` (link only, doc not created). Header receipt block added in the sibling style.

**`public/landing/nocturne/poster.png`** — a **real capture**: the live app on `:3000` at `/nocturne?embed=1`, headless Chromium via the sibling poster lane's pipeline (`scripts/landing_demo_poster.mjs`'s 1440×900 @2x = **2880×1800**, matching the pinned IHDR), zero non-HMR console errors (HMR WebSocket noise is an environment artifact of running against a dev server; the committed sibling posters were shot the same way). No drawing, no placeholder.

**Tests** — `live-demo.test.tsx`: gallery count 7, distinct-everything pins extended, the nocturne entry-shape block (resetType/route/url/poster/receiptDoc + the counted receipt figures), and the reset-handshake switch to the seventh tab posting `nocturne-reset` with a pinned origin. `built-improved.test.tsx`: the gallery-ordinal pin updated 6→Aria/sixth to **7→Nocturne/seventh** (the band derives it data-driven via `ordinalOf`).

**Out-of-lane defect found + fixed** — `src/app/nocturne/status/[slug]/` shipped a `route.ts` **and** a `page.tsx` in one folder; Next 16 hard-errors the whole app ("Conflicting route and page") so *every* page 500'd until it was resolved. Since the provider fetches that URL as JSON, the route is load-bearing and the `page.tsx` shell was the redundant member — it was deleted (the JSON lane is exercised by the 78 API tests; no test or link depended on the HTML shell).

## Verification
- `bun test src` — **1909/1909 pass**, 0 fail (14168 expects)
- `bun run typecheck` — clean
- `bun run build` — production build succeeds (all nocturne routes listed)
- `node scripts/landing_audit.mjs` — **cannot run in this environment**: it launches Playwright chromium headless-shell 1248, which isn't installed here (only 1200 is). Environment limitation, not a code defect; the gallery DOM contract it checks is already pinned by the landing test suite.

Not committed, per the instructions.
